newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Rhodes to begin trading in Vancouver.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Rhodes to begin trading in Vancouver.

text.p: Australian junior miner Rhodes Mining NL said its shares and options would begin trading on the Vancouver Stock Exchange on September 3.
Rhodes said its shares and 1998 options (called warrants in Canada) would be quoted on the resource section of the senior board of the Vancouver exchange.

With its current symbols for trading on the Australian Stock Exchange not available in Vancouver, new symbols had been assigned common to both exchanges - RHO.AX and RHO.V for its ordinary shares, RHOO.AX for the options and RHO.WT for the warrants.
The Australian symbol change is effective September 2.

Rhodes said drilling had begun at its exploration licence at Javorie in Slovakia in a programme of inclined diamond drill holes to test the continuity of gold mineralisation discovered on the face of the Podpolom quarry and a nearby outcrop.
Channel sampling on the quarry face revealed two bands of gold mineralisation, 2.3 grams per tonne of gold at 14 metres width and 2.8 g/t at 56 metres, including 5.0 g/t at 26 metres, it said.
Rhodes shares closed at 24 cents on Tuesday.
